creator: U.S. Navy photo by Photographer's Mate 1st Class William R. Goodwin.
alt: A US Navy optician adjusting eyeglasses in 2002, used as historical service context; this is not a Lenskart store.
description: Pearl Harbor, Hawaii (Oct. 29, 2002) -- Navy Exchange Optician Jeane Bueheler adjusts a customer's glasses at the new optical shop located at the “Mall at Pearl Harbor.” The 350,000 square foot mall houses the largest Navy Exchange in the world, the largest Department of Defense Commissary in Hawaii, and was designed based on recommendations from customers through surveys and focus groups. U.S. Navy photo by Photographer's Mate 1st Class William R. Goodwin. (RELEASED)
